title: Development of a cell-penetrating peptide for intracellular delivery of a biologically active HPV E6 inhibitor in cervical cancer cells.
authors: Dassi, Luisa; Tornesello, Anna Lucia; Vincenzi, Marian; Leone, Marilisa; Ingangi, Vincenzo; Lu, Wuyuan; Cerasuolo, Andrea; Pecchillo Cimmino, Tiziana; Amiranda, Sara; Napolitano, Mariapia; Tirino, Palma; Tuccillo, Franca Maria; Buonaguro, Luigi; De Gregorio, Vincenza; Imparato, Giorgia; Buonaguro, Franco Maria; Tornesello, Maria Lina
journal: Journal of experimental & clinical cancer research : CR
one_liner_zh: 该文开发穿膜肽递送HPV E6抑制剂，虽用AlphaFold2建模E6-肽互作，但核心是细胞实验与治疗应用，非TF-DNA结合机制研究，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The E6 oncoprotein of high-risk human papillomaviruses (HPVs) promotes cervical carcinogenesis by forming a complex with the ubiquitin ligase E6AP to mediate p53 proteasomal degradation. A 15-amino-acid peptide (pep11) was shown to disrupt the HPV16 E6/E6AP complex, to restore p53 stability and to induce apoptosis in HPV16-positive cancer cells. In this study, a short cell-penetrating peptide (CPP) was conjugated to the pep11 N-terminus to improve its solubility and intracellular delivery in HPV-positive cancer cells. METHODS: CPP-pep11 was synthesized using Boc chemistry. The interactions of CPP-pep11 with HPV16 and HPV18 E6 were modelled using AlphaFold2, while peptide structures were characterised by NMR spectroscopy. HPV16-positive SiHa and HPV18-positive C4-I cervical cancer cells were treated with CPP-pep11 (0.5-20 microM) for 24-72 h. Effects on proliferation and clonogenicity were assessed using xCELLigence and colony formation assays. Peptide uptake and localization were analysed by confocal microscopy and differential cell fractionation, while p53 expression and viability were evaluated by Western blotting and cytotoxicity assays. RESULTS: AlphaFold2 modelling suggested that CPP-pep11 can interact with both HPV16 E6 and HPV18 E6, with a more stable predicted binding to HPV16 E6. CPP-pep11 was soluble in water at 20 microM and, according to NMR analysis, predominantly adopted a disordered conformation. CPP-pep11 efficiently entered the SiHa and C4-I cell membranes, mainly localised to the cytoplasm at lower concentrations (0.5-5 microM) and to the nucleus at higher concentrations (10-20 microM). CPP-pep11 induced dose- and time-dependent inhibition of proliferation, with a significant reduction in colony formation in both cell lines. Treatment also restored p53 levels at 48 and 72 h, consistent with disruption of E6-mediated degradation. CONCLUSIONS: In conclusion, CPP-pep11 is a novel peptide-based inhibitor of HPV16 E6 and HPV18 E6 with therapeutic potential in HPV-associated malignancies by restoring p53 levels and inhibiting cancer cell proliferation.
abstract_zh: 背景：高危型人乳头瘤病毒（HPVs）的E6癌蛋白通过与泛素连接酶E6AP形成复合物，介导p53的蛋白酶体降解，从而促进宫颈癌发生。已有研究表明，一种15氨基酸肽（pep11）能够破坏HPV16 E6/E6AP复合物，恢复p53稳定性，并在HPV16阳性癌细胞中诱导凋亡。本研究将一种短细胞穿透肽（CPP）偶联至pep11的N端，以改善其在HPV阳性癌细胞中的溶解性和细胞内递送。方法：采用Boc化学法合成CPP-pep11。使用AlphaFold2对CPP-pep11与HPV16和HPV18 E6的相互作用进行建模，同时通过NMR光谱表征肽结构。用CPP-pep11（0.5-20微摩尔）处理HPV16阳性SiHa和HPV18阳性C4-I宫颈癌细胞24-72小时。通过xCELLigence和集落形成实验评估增殖和克隆形成能力的影响。通过共聚焦显微镜和差异细胞分级分析肽的摄取和定位，同时通过Western blotting和细胞毒性实验评估p53表达和细胞活力。结果：AlphaFold2建模提示，CPP-pep11可与HPV16 E6和HPV18 E6相互作用，且对HPV16 E6的预测结合更稳定。CPP-pep11在20微摩尔浓度下可溶于水，根据NMR分析，主要采用无序构象。CPP-pep11能有效进入SiHa和C4-I细胞膜，在较低浓度（0.5-5微摩尔）下主要定位于细胞质，在较高浓度（10-20微摩尔）下主要定位于细胞核。CPP-pep11诱导剂量和时间依赖性的增殖抑制，并在两种细胞系中显著减少集落形成。处理还在48和72小时恢复p53水平，与E6介导降解的破坏一致。结论：总之，CPP-pep11是一种新型基于肽的HPV16 E6和HPV18 E6抑制剂，通过恢复p53水平和抑制癌细胞增殖，在HPV相关恶性肿瘤中具有治疗潜力。
